page_title: UNI 2-1 FRE | Union Berlin v Freiburg 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) has received a yellow card for his foul.
90+7' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) for a tough tackle.
90+6' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
90+2' 2 - 1 Goal! Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 2:1.
90+2' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) fails to score from the penalty as his shot only hits the right post.
90+2' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+2' A player from Freiburg commits a rough challenge. Christian Dingert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Union Berlin are awarded a penalty.
90+1' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' Freiburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' Florent Muslija (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
85' The referee gives a yellow card to Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
85' 1 - 1 Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) leaps to meet a beautiful cross and produces a header which goes low inside the right post.
84' Marco Grote has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Paul Jaeckel (Union Berlin) replacing Josip Juranovic.
84' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin.
83' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Substitution. Nicolas Hofler did his best and is replaced by Florent Muslija (Freiburg).
82' Freiburg earn a corner.
80' Marco Grote decides to make a substitution. Brenden Aaronson will be replaced by Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin).
80' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
77' Here's the change. Roland Sallai leaves the pitch and Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
75' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Christian Dingert's book.
75' The main referee, Christian Dingert, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is given a yellow card for dissent.
73' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
70' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
68' 1 - 0 Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
67' Today's referee Christian Dingert rightly decides to book Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) for his harsh tackle.
65' It's a throw-in for Freiburg.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diogo Leite departs the field of play to be replaced by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin).
63' Marco Grote has decided to substitute Yorbe Vertessen and he is replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
62' Here comes a substitution. Andras Schafer is given a rest as he is replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
61' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.
59' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Lucas Holer is replaced by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg).
59' Substitution. Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Christian Gunter walks off.
59' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
58' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
56' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
54' What was Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
54' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
53' Freiburg are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
52' Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Christian Dingert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
52' The goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny Roland Sallai (Freiburg) as he jumps for a header from a brilliant cross into the penalty area.
50' It looks like Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) saw red with that tackle. Christian Dingert won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
49' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Freiburg.
47' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Freiburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45+2' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg), but the defence gets it clear. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
42' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
41' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot on goal, but the ball curls just wide of the right post.
38' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the right post, but Noah Atubolu leaps out to thwart his attempt.
38' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
37' The Union Berlin players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
37' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

36' Play continues despite the shouts by some Union Berlin players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Christian Dingert interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
35' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
33' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
29' None of the Union Berlin players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

25' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
23' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
22' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
19' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
18' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
15' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
12' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.

10' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Union Berlin.
7' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
5' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) sends a long ball in, but Frederik Ronnow comfortably gathers the ball.
4' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Noah Atubolu is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
2' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Freiburg will take the kick-off.
Christian Dingert will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
Hello and welcome to our live text commentary! We will provide you with instant updates of everything that happens in the match. The starting lineups will be announced very soon.
